subject: Reserved pool uplift + executive credit request (Kestrel AI)
messages:
From: Aisha Collins <aisha.collins@kestrelai.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: Chris Tan <chris.tan@kestrelai.com>, procurement@kestrelai.com
Date: 2027-06-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal discussion - reserved GPU top-up and pricing ask

Jonas,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. Quick recap from our side and a concrete ask so your team can route internally: Kestrel plans to increase our Reserved pool from 16 -> 40 A100-equivalent GPUs at the next renewal (term reset 2027-07-31). This is a firm, 12-month commit.

Key commercial asks: a one-time onboarding/burst-testing credit to offset initial migration and validation costs, plus a modest unit-price concession for the larger commit. Our board packet needs a written commercial term by 2027-06-25.

High level numbers: current committed spend ~ $72k/mo. Proposed committed spend at new size ~ $190k/mo. Were asking for either a one-time credit in the $120k-$150k range OR a blended option (smaller one-time credit + multi-month blended discount) that yields similar cash impact.

Attached: short renewal summary and usage snapshots.

Can you confirm what level of commercial concession requires executive sign-off and the earliest you could provide a written term? Happy to hop on a call.

Thanks,
Aisha Collins
Co-founder, Head of Platform, Kestrel AI

---
Attachment: Kestrel_renewal_summary_Q2_27.pdf (3 pages)

From: jonas.weber@redwood.com
To: Aisha Collins <aisha.collins@kestrelai.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-12T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion - reserved GPU top-up and pricing ask

Thanks Aisha  clear ask and timeline. We can support the 12-month committed pool; credits of the size youre requesting are atypical but plausible for strategic customers with strong growth signals.

Two quick operational clarifications that drive cost: 1) will you need throughput/tail-latency SLOs (e.g., 95th percentile guarantees) for the expanded pool, or only capacity reservation? 2) target go-live/start-of-term for the expanded reserve (you noted term reset 7/31  is the expansion starting 8/1?).

Ive looped Marissa (Sales Lead) and Vanessa (Partnerships) to scope the commercial path and surface to Finance. Expect a follow-up with a proposed commercial structure tomorrow.

Jonas
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

> On 2027-06-12, Aisha Collins wrote:
> > Jonas, ... (see attachment)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-12T11:42:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal discussion - reserved GPU top-up and pricing ask

Looping Rishi for commercial approval guidance. Jonas  thanks for the summary.

High level: Kestrels growth trajectory and the size of this uplift make them strategically important. The one-time credit range they propose is material but defensible if matched with a firm 12-month commit (and protections).

Rishi  please run economics on two concrete options by EOD tomorrow: 
1) One-time credit: $130,000 applied to the first invoice (customer prefers an explicit number for the board pack).
2) Blended: 15% unit discount for months 1-3 plus a $60,000 one-time credit.

Also propose a usage protection clause: if sustained committed utilization < 85% for >=2 consecutive months, Redwood may re-evaluate pricing or apply a clawback. We should bake standard SLO exceptions and a 90-day limited burst pool (10 GPUs) into the amendment.

Marissa
Head of Sales  US, Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: proposed_amendment_12mo_topup.docx (tracked changes)

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-13T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal discussion - reserved GPU top-up and pricing ask

Quick econ run attached (spreadsheet in internal drive). Summary below: 
Option A (one-time credit $130k): 12-month ARR uplift ~ $2.16M; blended gross margin impact year 1: ~6.8% reduction vs baseline; payback via committed cash in < 2 months.
Option B (15% for 3 months + $60k credit): similar cash impact but revenue recognition is spread; gross margin impact slightly lower in month 1 but longer tail risk.

Recommendation: Approve Option A ($130k one-time credit) conditional on: 1) signed 12-month amendment with minimum monthly commitment clause and utilization protection (>=85% utilization), 2) 30-day clawback period if material underutilization and 3) engineering SRE scope limited to capacity reservation (no hard tail-latency SLA) unless Kestrel purchases throughput SLO addon.

If Sales wants a smaller headline number for the board pack, we can phrase it as a $130k implementation credit allocated across the first invoice(s).

Rishi
VP, Revenue Operations (Finance)

> Attachment: internal_econ_kestrel_Q2_27.xlsx (internal)

From: jonas.weber@redwood.com
To: Aisha Collins <aisha.collins@kestrelai.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-14T09:55:00-07:00
Subject: Proposed term summary for Kestrel uplift (draft)

Aisha  following internal review, attached is a draft commercial term to include in your board pack. High level: 40x reserved GPUs (A100-equivalent), 12-month term starting 2027-08-01, one-time implementation credit $130,000 applied to first invoice, 99.5% pooled availability target, optional 90-day burst pool (+10 GPUs) on a trial basis. Utilization protection: if average sustained utilization <85% for two consecutive months, Redwood may re-trigger pricing review and apply contractual protections.

We also called out SRE scope: capacity reservation and reasonable deployment support only. Any throughput/latency SLO beyond capacity reservation is an add-on.

If that aligns, can you confirm and we'll produce an amendment with tracked changes for signature. We can provide a short cover note summarizing the cash impact for your board.

Jonas
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: draft_term_summary_Kestrel_40GPU.pdf

From: Aisha Collins <aisha.collins@kestrelai.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: Chris Tan <chris.tan@kestrelai.com>, procurement@kestrelai.com
Date: 2027-06-15T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed term summary for Kestrel uplift (draft)

Jonas, thanks  that draft aligns with what were trying to present. Well include the $130k implementation credit line item in the board materials and flag the utilization protections. Procurement will review the amendment and follow up with any redlines; we may ask for one small edit to the first-invoice allocation language so the finance team can model the board effect as a single-line credit.

Next steps: procurement will aim to get the amendment reviewed by 2027-06-20 and well target signature by the end of July so the expanded pool can start 2027-08-01. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Aisha
Co-founder, Head of Platform, Kestrel AI
